hero.intro: Send targeted messages to groups of patients (reactivation, birthday, announcements). Limit: 200 sends/day. Patients are end-to-end encrypted — the backend only learns who has a valid email after you open the campaign.

js.audienceCount: {{total}} patients in the audience · {{eligible}} with a valid email = eligible to send.
js.alertSelectAudience: Select an audience with valid emails first.
js.confirmSend: Send this campaign to {{n}} patients? This counts toward the daily limit (200/day).
js.alertFillSubjectBody: Fill in the subject and message.

reativacao-suave.label: Gentle reactivation
reativacao-suave.subject: It's been a while, how are you?
reativacao-suave.bodyHint: Good for lapsed-3m. Tone: caring, no pressure.
reativacao-suave.bodyMd:
Hi [NOME_PACIENTE],

It's been a while since our last conversation. I just wanted to let you know I'm here if you'd like to pick things back up.

No pressure — just a reminder that the door is still open.

Warm regards,
[NOME_PROFISSIONAL]

reativacao-firme.label: Firm reactivation
reativacao-firme.subject: Shall we pick things back up?
reativacao-firme.bodyHint: Good for lapsed-6m. Tone: inviting, direct.
reativacao-firme.bodyMd:
Hi [NOME_PACIENTE],

It's been more than 6 months since our last session. I wanted to ask: does it make sense for us to pick things back up?

I have open slots this week. If you'd like, just reply to this email with a day/time and I'll schedule it.

[NOME_PROFISSIONAL]

aniversario.label: Birthday
aniversario.subject: Happy birthday, [NOME_PACIENTE]!
aniversario.bodyHint: For the birthday-month audience. Short and warm.
aniversario.bodyMd:
Hi [NOME_PACIENTE],

Wishing you health, lightness, and time to take care of what matters to you in this new cycle.

Warm regards,
[NOME_PROFISSIONAL]

novidade.label: Announce news
novidade.subject: [Espaço Prelúdio] News from the practice
novidade.bodyHint: For the all audience. Use to announce vacations, new hours, etc.
